1. (Currently amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; __a remote station in communication with the physiological monitor; and a processor programmed to send an output from the physiological monitor to the remote station, wherein the output triggers a second alarm at the remote station in response to the alarm condition, and wherein the processor is further programmed to receive an input from the remote station that causes the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm__.

2. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein __the escalated alarm__ is capable of being acknowledged by an operator input before expiration of a timer.

3. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an inaudible alarm __and the second alarm comprises an audible alarm__.

4. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the escalated alarm comprises __an audible alarm that is triggered only when neither the first alarm nor the second alarm is acknowledged within a predetermined time period__.

5. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an audible alarm and the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm that is __at least perceptibly louder than the first alarm and is triggered only when the first alarm is not acknowledged within a predetermined time period__.

6. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm and the second alarm are triggered substantially simultaneously __and the escalated alarm is triggered only upon failure to acknowledge either the first alarm or the second alarm within a predetermined time period__.

7. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the remote station located remotely from the physiological monitor is part of a central patient management system __and is in wireless communication with the physiological monitor__.

16. (Currently amended) A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition and to escalate the alarm if not acknowledged within a predetermined time period; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type, a time that the alarm was triggered, __a level of escalation, and an acknowledgement status__; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data __including the escalation level and acknowledgement status__.

17. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system __and further comprises a remote station in communication with the physiological monitor__.

18. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises __stored__ information about a level of escalation of the alarm __including whether the alarm has escalated from a first alarm to a second alarm to an escalated alarm__.

19. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm __including a timestamp of when the alarm was acknowledged and which alarm level was acknowledged__.

20. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data to one or more wireless devices __only when the alarm has escalated and remains unacknowledged after a predetermined time period__.
